Game Overview

Red VS Blue is a two-player title where dive into the chaotic fun of Red Vs Blue Multiplayer, where two players sprint through an endless isometric world on a single keyboard. Compete neck-and-neck, dodging obstacles and outpacing each other in a fast-paced, adrenaline-pumping marathon. Who will emerge victorious, the Reds or the Blues?
